 bet365 Champions League preview
 It’s the third round of the Champions League this week, with the League Phase table starting to take shape. There’s some huge matches, including PSG vs Barcelona, but our preview focuses on Bayern Munich vs Arsenal.
 Bayern vs Arsenal preview (Wednesday 8pm)
 Bayern Munich face Arsenal in Germany, and the home side will want revenge after the Gunners beat them at the Emirates last season. 
 One thing this game should promise is goals. Harry Kane is in great form, and some people suggest he could win the Ballon d’Or, while Bukayo Saka and Martin Odegaard have made their mark in the Champions League this season. 
 Arsenal will be buoyed by the fact that Michael Olise is suspended, but Bayern still have great attackers to play alongside Kane, including Jamal Musiala and Luiz Diaz.
 One thing the Gunners pride themselves on is their world-class defence. They are yet to concede in the Champions League this season and they have only conceded five goals in the Premier League. 
 This is one of the big matches of the week, and no doubt many will be tuning in and hoping we are watching an entertaining match between two big European clubs.
